other_conditions: Must belong to a minority community
Minimum educational qualification is at least 8th/10th pass, subject to course‑specific requirements
30% reservation for women and 3% reservation for disabled; unfilled reserved seats may be allocated to other minority applicants
A refundable security deposit of ₹1,000 is required at enrollment
benefits_summary: Provides vocational skill training and easy loans for self‑employment to minority community members aged 18‑45.
